t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on deep navy. Top left: a small breadcrumb and wordmark, a large light-weight white sans headline and a one-line intro. Left 40%: a square off-white card holding an isometric technical line drawing of white equipment on a frame, uniform hairline strokes, no shading, catalogue style. Right: a five-row table with a white hairline grid and mono reference cells for <CONTENT>. Row numerals 01-05 sit outside the grid and send elbowed hairline leaders into points on the drawing. Square corners, calm.
signature_idea: A regulation crosswalk where each clause row reaches across the page with a leader into the skid drawing that implements it.
strengths: leaders from rows into the drawing work and read clearly

weaknesses: skid drawn looks like stainless tanks and cabinets, not obviously PP

invented clause numbers and retention figures in cells

brand_fit_why: Navy and limestone, light headline, mono references and hairline line art fit, but the dense grid table and stainless-looking skid pull it off-offer.
